visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands with long, black-manicured nails holds a photocard of a male artist in front of a white box. The background is a soft, neutral-colored carpet. (2) The hands reach into a white box lined with green artificial grass to lift out a large lightstick shaped like a white daisy with a yellow center and a black handle. (3) In a darkened indoor setting, the daisy lightstick is held up, glowing with cycling rainbow colors against a dark fabric background. (4) Hands open a black envelope embossed with gold text reading 'Übermensch' and reveal a stack of high-quality postcards featuring various portraits of a male artist. (5) Two rolls of decorative tape, one black and one white with colorful text, are removed from a black plastic bag and presented to the camera. (6) A light blue pajama shirt with pink piping and a small 'U' logo on the pocket is spread out on the soft carpet. (7) A dark grey, thick fleece bathrobe is unfolded, revealing detailed white 'Übermensch' embroidery on the back and a 'U' logo on the chest area. (8) A pair of black slippers featuring a white 'U' logo is held up against the dark background of the previously shown bathrobe. (9) A black bucket hat with a pink logo and a 'U' symbol on the side is showcased by the hands. (10) A black hooded sweatshirt is displayed, featuring a repetitive grid of 'Übermensch' text and a large pink 'U' logo in the center. (11) Several polaroid-style photocards showing the artist with green hair are fanned out in front of a background of green garden foliage.
